summary: Verification certifying individual has no active criminal convictions, arrest warrants, or pending FIRs.

steps.title: Submit online verification request
steps.description: Enter personal biographical history, previous 5 years addresses, and employer requisition letter.

steps.title: Crime database cross-checking
steps.description: Police records branch verifies applicant against CCTNS (Crime and Criminal Tracking Network).

steps.title: Local police station enquiry
steps.description: Local beat constable verifies applicant character from two reputable neighborhood references.

steps.title: Download Police Clearance Certificate
steps.description: Download digitally stamped Character Verification Certificate with validity QR code.
